offering_description.value: BKV produces natural gas and generates electricity. It integrates those operations with midstream and carbon capture, and its Texas power business targets demand from data centers and industrial users.

quotes.quote: This is energy reengineered. BKV’s business lines don’t operate in silos. Instead, they operate as a system. Spanning natural gas, midstream, power generation and carbon capture, our closed-loop model is designed to outperform, driving resilience, expanding opportunity and redefining how energy is produced, delivered and sustained.

We’re meeting growing electricity demand head-on. With existing power generation assets and clear pathways to scale, we’re perfectly positioned at the nexus of AI, data-center and industrial expansion in Texas.
